items.caption: A modern redraw presents 汽 in Shuowen small-seal style. The reported Shuowen analysis treats water as the meaning element and 气 as the sound element.
items.alt: Black, seal-script-style rendering of 汽 on a white background.
items.selection_reason: It illustrates the reported small-seal form and gives a visual reference for the character, though its internal shapes are not clear enough to identify the components from the image alone.

limitations.text: This is a modern digital redraw, not an ancient specimen. Earlier graphic development and the date of this form remain undocumented.
